mapper.select: WITH actual AS ( SELECT a.job_cd, COALESCE(sum(m.mon_mm),0) AS actual_mm FROM tb_pj_asgn a LEFT JOIN tb_pj_asgn_mon m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.proj_id=a.proj_id AND m.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' GROUP BY a.job_cd ), jobs AS ( SELECT job_cd FROM tb_pj_mnpw_plan WHERE proj_id=#{id} UNION SELECT job_cd FROM actual ) SELECT j.job_cd AS "jobCode", COALESCE(c.code_nm,j.job_cd) AS "jobName", CASE WHEN c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "useYn", p.plan_mm AS "planMm", COALESCE(a.actual_mm,0) AS "actualMm", p.src_cd AS "source" FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN tb_pj_mnpw_plan p ON p.proj_id=#{id} AND p.job_cd=j.job_cd LEFT JOIN actual a ON a.job_cd=j.job_cd LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code c ON c.code_grp_id='JOB' AND c.code=j.job_cd ORDER BY c.sort_ord NULLS LAST,j.job_cd

SELECT c.code FROM tb_sy_code c JOIN tb_sy_code_grp g ON g.code_grp_id=c.code_grp_id WHERE c.code_grp_id='JOB' AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N' AND g.use_yn='Y' AND length(c.code)<=10 ORDER BY c.sort_ord,c.code
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_pj_mnpw_plan SET plan_mm=#{planMm},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND job_cd=#{jobCode}
